svg.text: Why do I keep losing to Lava Hound?
I can't figure out the right counter timing.
Great question. Lava Hound is a nightmare for Hog 2.6 if you don't
respect the balloon drop. Here's what I see in your last 3 losses:
1. You're playing Hog before their Lava Hound crosses the bridge.
2. Your Musketeer is being used defensively too early.
Fix: Hold your Fireball for the Balloon, not the Hound itself. The
Hound does minimal tower damage — the Balloon is the killer.
